note: Seeded implementer tasks replayed by `workflow bench --implementer`. Each fixture is a small project whose AGENTS.md lists ddd and hexagonal-architecture under active_skills; the gate is its argv. Checks are deterministic: layers (no domain import of an app, api or infra path), primitives (no raw string, number or boolean on a public domain signature), red (the new test fails on the starting tree), gate and, for a task that names a guard, guard (the run's tests fail once that guard is removed from the final tree).

issue.title: feat(users): change a user's email address
issue.body:
## Summary

A registered user can change their email address.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Changing a user's email to a different address returns the changed user and a `UserEmailChanged` event.
- [ ] Changing it to the address the user already has reports no change and records no event.
- [ ] A use case `changeUserEmail` takes a user id and a new address as text, loads the user, and reports `UserNotFound` when there is none.
- [ ] Each criterion has a test, and the project gate passes.

issue.title: feat(orders): cancel an order before it ships
issue.body:
## Summary

A placed order can be cancelled until it ships.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Cancelling a placed order returns the cancelled order and an `OrderCancelled` event.
- [ ] Cancelling a shipped order is refused and the order is unchanged.
- [ ] A use case `cancelOrder` takes an order id as text, loads the order, and reports `OrderNotFound` when there is none.
- [ ] Each criterion has a test, and the project gate passes.

issue.title: feat(stock): reserve stock for an order
issue.body:
## Summary

Stock that is on hand can be reserved, never beyond what is still available (on hand minus reserved). Another reservation may change the stored item between our read and our write.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Reserving a quantity within the available stock returns the item with that quantity added to `reserved` and a `StockReserved` event.
- [ ] Reserving more than the available stock reports `InsufficientStock` and stores nothing.
- [ ] A use case `reserveStock` takes a sku and a quantity as numbers and text, loads the item, and reports `UnknownSku` when there is none.
- [ ] When the item changed between the read and the write (the save is refused), the use case reports `Conflict` and the stored item keeps the other writer's reservation, so the reserved total never exceeds what is on hand.
- [ ] Each criterion has a test, and the project gate passes.

issue.title: feat(intake): accept a submission from a trusted author
issue.body:
## Summary

An author's submission is accepted only when the author is trusted. The domain already decides this in `admit`; the use case must go through it.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A use case `acceptSubmission` takes an author id and a title as text, loads the author, and reports `UnknownAuthor` when there is none.
- [ ] A submission from a trusted author is stored and the use case reports `Accepted`.
- [ ] A submission from an untrusted author is refused through `admit`: the use case reports `Refused` and stores nothing.
- [ ] Each criterion has a test, and the project gate passes.
